hints.title: Count the units that must stay unique
hints.body: Every filled cell belongs to exactly three units: one row, one column, and one 3x3 box. A grid is valid when no unit contains the same digit twice.

hints.title: Keep 27 sets
hints.body: Maintain nine sets for rows, nine for columns, and nine for boxes. For each non-empty cell, check membership in all three relevant sets before adding the digit.

hints.title: Map a cell to its box
hints.body: The box index is `(row // 3) * 3 + (column // 3)`. This numbers boxes left to right, top to bottom. Do not skip empty cells by treating `'.'` as a digit.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
rows = 9 empty sets
cols = 9 empty sets
boxes = 9 empty sets
for row from 0 to 8:
    for col from 0 to 8:
        value = board[row][col]
        if value == '.': continue
        box = (row // 3) * 3 + (col // 3)
        if value in rows[row] or value in cols[col] or value in boxes[box]:
            return false
        add value to rows[row], cols[col], and boxes[box]
return true
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
